en.answer: If the equipped monster attacks another monster, but the attack is negated by <<4804>>, the effect of <<11886>> will not activate during the End Phase.
en.question: If a monster equipped with <<11886>> declares an attack on a monster, but the attack is negated by <<4804>>, will the effect of <<11886>> that destroys itself still activate during the End Phase?
